author: Codex documentation author; corrections by DOC-029 source-review author agent (admin-config)

prerequisites: Seeded fictional Administrator signed in on the admin2 documentation lab built from 57e77e38.
Reviewer-created Matter, Contract, Entity and Knowledge types, Fields, Statuses, an Officer role, a fictional Entity with a current and a resigned Officer, and a fictional Matter.
scenarios.expected: Types, Statuses and Officer roles are added with Save (Save status for Statuses), and Cancel discards a draft. Rows can be renamed, reordered, edited and archived as the article says. Contracts and Matters Fields show a collapsed Default fields card of locked, read-only rows above an expanded Custom Fields card that holds Add field. The Slug and a Status's Stage or Category stay fixed. Requiredness blocks creation until the value is supplied. Detach and Archive keep stored values. Archiving an in-use type, Matter Status or Officer role needs a live replacement and moves the records; Restore does not move them back. Protected entries cannot be archived, an in-use Contract Status cannot be archived from the dialog, and narrowing a Global Field attached elsewhere is refused. Non-Administrators cannot open or change the configuration.
scenarios.actual: 15 recorded steps passed on 57e77e38. Add type showed a name box with Save and Cancel; Save was disabled while the box was blank. Cancel on a named draft created no row (checked after reload). Add type with Save added Matter, Contract, Entity and Knowledge types; Contracts and Entities rows have Edit and Knowledge rows do not. Rename, Edit (description saved on Tab, read-only Slug that kept the original name) and ArrowUp reorder worked on Matter types; Other shows the protected lock. On Matters and Contracts Fields, Default fields sits above Custom Fields with aria-expanded=false and no rows shown; selecting its heading showed 15 (Matters) and 23 (Contracts) rows, each with a "<name>: built-in field, read-only here" lock and no row buttons or text boxes. Custom Fields started expanded with Add field. Entities Fields has one Fields card and no Default fields card. Add field offered Text, Long text, Number, Currency, Date, Boolean, Single select, Multi select, User, Entity; Edit shows no Type control; the Field catalog has no reorder handles. A required attached Field refused Create matter with "Fill <Field>." until Privacy was chosen. Promote to Global saved; narrowing back was refused with "... is attached outside the matter module — detach it there first, then narrow the scope." until the Contract type attachment was detached. Detach kept the catalog Field; Archive hid the Field while the Matter kept its value; Show archived > Restore brought it back. Archiving the in-use Matter type with "No reassignment" changed nothing; with a replacement the Matter moved, and Restore left it there. A new Contract Status added with Stage Review and Save status kept Stage Review after rename; Draft, Active and Expired are locked; the in-use Internal review dialog said "Move them to another status first." with Archive status disabled. A new Open Matter Status added with Save status and no group choice used group In progress, a Waiting Status kept Waiting after rename, and a row group change persisted; archiving an in-use Status offered only Open-Category replacements and moved the Matter. Add role with Save created an Officer role; with one current and one resigned Officer it counted 2 officers, Archive role moved both to Director, and Restore left 0 officers on it.

limitations: Independent agent walkthrough by a different agent from the author and technical reviewer; not a human user study and not feature-owner approval.

The admin2 lab was shared with other DOC-029r2 agents. Records were named DOC-029r2 admin-config walk. Records named DOC-029r2 admin-config compat came from another agent and were not changed. Organisation reminder lead times were changed during the run and restored to 30, 14, 7, 1, and On the day; this was confirmed after reload.

Two development runs of single sections of the same script (logs not kept in the repository) left extra fictional records with the suffixes mu4erz3c and mu4ev57k. The one failure in those runs was a reviewer script error; walkthrough-r2-1.json reviewerNotes describes it.
Negative access checks used the seeded Legal Team Member (nadia.haddad) and Business User (jonas.weber), each in its own browser context; roles were confirmed from /api/v1/me.

Dev commits 6d34ac59 and e3800b43 changed this article on dev (select Save instead of press Enter, and the Default fields paragraph). The round 2 source-review author agent made no further change; technical-review-r2.json records the source check.

Not checked in the browser: requiredness when a record changes type, the rule that every Stage or Category keeps a live Status, reopening after a failed multi-part Field save, and the Contract Field AI prompt (covered by configure-analysis).
Archive type with No reassignment on an in-use type left the dialog open with no message; the refusal is silent but nothing changed.
The Field archive dialog counted a Field attached to one type as 'attached to 2 types'.
The Officer role check used the Director role as the replacement on a reviewer-created Entity; no seeded Officer was changed.
